Teamcenter

Teamcenter provides product-lifecycle data, configuration and change-management workflows.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Find a controlled product record

Start from the controlled identifier, current revision and relationship context. In the intended Teamcenter preview, find a controlled product record; the visible result is the matching record, document or model tree with ownership visible. Review source system, revision, permissions and record identity before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare an engineering change

Begin with the proposed change, exchange or coordination package. In the intended Teamcenter preview, prepare an engineering change; the visible result is a versioned change set with affected objects and approvals exposed. Review scope, dependencies, recipients and comparison accuracy before accepting or exporting it.

Review release status

Use the release, transmittal or review criteria. In the intended Teamcenter preview, review release status; the visible result is a traceable status view with history and outstanding decisions. Review approvers, effective revision, audit trail and delivery state before accepting or exporting it.
